newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil see-saws on futures, ends lower.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil see-saws on futures, ends lower.

text.p: Stronger IPE gas oil futures boosted NWE physical gas oil early, but prices retraced later leaving levels about $1-2 below yesterday's levels.
March IPE gas oil closed $1.75 lower at $162.00 a tonne, but had traded as high as $167.
Trader talk that the market had bottomed out this week after sustained losses on the front month contract since the end of January lost credance as futures lost ground.
Buyers and sellers remained fairly wide apart - demand remains fundementally muted while sellers are suffering from tight margins.
The crude/gas oil spread on Wednesday was around $16.50 a tonne compared with $33 this time last year.
Heating oil barge activity was fairly light although a very prompt barge was done at March IPE +50 cents fob ARA, but this was seen to be above the market.
"It was very prompt, like this afternoon, the rest of the market is around buyers at March IPE -50 and sellers at +50 cents, about 50 cents from Tuesday.
Diesel premiums were $1 or so weaker.
A diesel barge was done at March IPE +10.50 fob ARA for first half March.
